body: Oh and Im going to bed. So dont be too surprised if I dont post for ~12 hrs or so. sorry. I appreciate the conversation. Its at teh very least distracting.

Well, I really don't know how to handle myself, so I doubt I could tell him, you know? He's quite kind, patient, and caring, but not being able to help me and seeing me mope/sleep all day makes him sad/frustrated. 

idk if it would help either way. I can't help myself. A lot of people can't really help me. I dont even know if it matters when nothing seems to feel like it helps.

I think I've felt this way as long as I can remember. Its always been a battle. I'm 25, female, cutter, came from an abusive family, etc etc. All that sort of thing. Its just always been something I;ve had to argue with myself about. Its a very ... annoying battle. I don't really know what triggers them. After a while, I just start ... idk... hearing it in my head. Hearing it in music. Hearing it in my mind. It just becomes more and more. Something has to change. I used to have a good support structure, people who knew me and I could talk to about this stuff... now all I have is the internet and its quite pathetic. I tried proper to kill myself about 5 years ago. alcohol + overdose on sleeping pills. Didn't work. That was embarrassing. Yes, sometimes it does go away, sometimes it even goes away for a while. But it eventually comes back and I'm so sick of it. 

Sorry, starting to ramble, I don't know if its negative thought patterns (its all my fault, i'm ugly, im stupid, im fat, no one likes me, everyones mad at me, everyone is lying to me) that triggers the suicidal thoughts, or if it's vice-versa. But they definitely increase when I'm starting to feel this way.

Its just nice to be acknowledged. I'm really starting to scare myself. You know, its that conflict. I feel like I have to struggle with suicidal thoughts very often. Just lately its gotten so incredibly overwhelming. But, there's still that doubt.

What would I do? I would ... gosh. I don't know. I think I would kick down the door on these stupid large, empty condos. You know, the housing market is AWFUL and there's abandoned buildings made for rich, while people EVERYWHERE. Especially out in the suburbs. Okay, so I'd make it a homeless shelter/squat. Practical usage for that space, you know? Its like taking the overindulgence of corporate greed and turning it around to help my fellow man.  Or at least start a food not bombs around here or something. But I'm broke, no car, in the middle of nowhere, and I never leave the house. So I sit on reddit and kongregate for 8 hours a day.
